tools.description: Posts an announcement of a feature flag change to the team's Slack channel via the configured incoming webhook, including the flag key, environment, old and new values, and who made the change.

params.name: changed_by
params.description: Name or handle of the person or agent who made the change.

tools.name: set_flag_rollout_percentage
tools.description: Sets the percentage rollout for a feature flag in a given environment in the flag store and adds an entry to the flag audit log recording the old and new percentage and the reason.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the feature flag to update.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment whose rollout should change, e.g. 'production'.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short justification recorded in the audit log.

import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool

FLAG_DB_PATH = os.environ.get("FLAG_DB_PATH", "/var/lib/flagstore/flags.db")


def _connect():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(FLAG_DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@function_tool
def set_flag_rollout_percentage(flag_key: str, environment: str, percentage: int, reason: str) -> dict:
    clamped = max(0, min(100, int(percentage)))
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = _connect()
    with conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT rollout_percentage FROM flag_environments WHERE flag_key = ? AND environment = ?",
            (flag_key, environment),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            conn.close()
            return {"ok": False, "error": f"Flag '{flag_key}' has no configuration in '{environment}'"}
        previous = row["rollout_percentage"]
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE flag_environments SET rollout_percentage = ?, updated_at = ? "
            "WHERE flag_key = ? AND environment = ?",
            (clamped, now, flag_key, environment),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO flag_audit_log (flag_key, environment, field, old_value, new_value, reason, created_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, 'rollout_percentage', ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (flag_key, environment, str(previous), str(clamped), reason, now),
        )
    conn.close()
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "flag_key": flag_key,
        "environment": environment,
        "previous_percentage": previous,
        "new_percentage": clamped,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

tools.name: update_service_config_value
tools.description: Writes a new value for a dotted config key (e.g. 'cache.ttl_seconds') into a service's YAML config file, creating intermediate sections if they don't exist. Returns the previous and new values.

params.name: service
params.description: Service name; its config is read from <CONFIG_ROOT>/<service>.yaml.

params.name: key_path
params.description: Dotted path to the config key, e.g. 'database.pool.max_size'.

params.name: value
params.description: New value as a YAML scalar string; it is parsed so '30' becomes an int and 'true' a boolean.

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path

import yaml
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("config-store")

CONFIG_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("CONFIG_ROOT", "/etc/app-config"))


@dataclass
class ConfigUpdateResult:
    service: str
    key_path: str
    previous_value: object
    new_value: object
    created_key: bool
    file: str


def _config_file(service: str) -> Path:
    safe = service.replace("/", "").replace("..", "")
    return CONFIG_ROOT / f"{safe}.yaml"


@mcp.tool()
def update_service_config_value(service: str, key_path: str, value: str) -> dict:
    path = _config_file(service)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No config file for service '{service}' at {path}")
    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text()) or {}
    parts = [p for p in key_path.split(".") if p]
    if not parts:
        raise ValueError("key_path must contain at least one key")
    node = data
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        child = node.get(part)
        if not isinstance(child, dict):
            child = {}
            node[part] = child
        node = child
    leaf = parts[-1]
    created = leaf not in node
    previous = node.get(leaf)
    parsed_value = yaml.safe_load(value)
    node[leaf] = parsed_value
    tmp_path = path.with_suffix(".yaml.tmp")
    tmp_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(data, sort_keys=False, default_flow_style=False))
    tmp_path.replace(path)
    result = ConfigUpdateResult(
        service=service,
        key_path=key_path,
        previous_value=previous,
        new_value=parsed_value,
        created_key=created,
        file=str(path),
    )
    return asdict(result)

tools.name: archive_retired_flag
tools.description: Moves a retired feature flag's definition file from the active flags directory into the archive directory and updates the flag manifest to mark it archived with the retirement note and date.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the flag to archive; its definition is flags/active/<flag_key>.json.

params.name: retirement_note
params.description: Why the flag is being retired, e.g. 'fully rolled out in v4.2'.

import json
import os
import shutil
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

FLAGS_REPO = Path(os.environ.get("FLAGS_REPO", "/srv/feature-flags"))
ACTIVE_DIR = FLAGS_REPO / "flags" / "active"
ARCHIVE_DIR = FLAGS_REPO / "flags" / "archived"
MANIFEST_PATH = FLAGS_REPO / "manifest.json"


@function_tool
def archive_retired_flag(flag_key: str, retirement_note: str) -> dict:
    source = ACTIVE_DIR / f"{flag_key}.json"
    if not source.exists():
        return {"ok": False, "error": f"No active definition for flag '{flag_key}'"}
    ARCHIVE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = ARCHIVE_DIR / f"{flag_key}.json"
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    today = date.today().isoformat()
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST_PATH.read_text())
    entry = manifest.setdefault("flags", {}).setdefault(flag_key, {})
    entry["status"] = "archived"
    entry["path"] = str(destination.relative_to(FLAGS_REPO))
    entry["archived_on"] = today
    entry["retirement_note"] = retirement_note
    manifest["active_count"] = sum(1 for f in manifest["flags"].values() if f.get("status") != "archived")
    MANIFEST_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "flag_key": flag_key,
        "moved_from": str(source),
        "moved_to": str(destination),
        "archived_on": today,
        "active_flag_count": manifest["active_count"],
    }
